player_prompt.intro:
Wo ne {role} wɔ Colonel Blotto.
Wo botae ne sɛ woadi nkunim wɔ round pii sen wo opponent.
Wɔ round biara mu no, fa {num_total_units} units na ɛkyɛ fields {field_names}.
Owura a ɔde units pii kɔ field bi no, ɔno na ɔdi nkunim wɔ saa field no, na owura a ɔdi nkunim wɔ fields pii no, ɔno na ɔdi nkunim wɔ round no.
Sɛ nhwɛso, '[A7 B7 C6]' fa units 7 kɔ A, 7 kɔ B, na 6 kɔ C.

game_state.header_round:
=== KOLONEL BLOTTO - Ɛpɔ {current_round}/{num_rounds} ===
Ɛpɔ a wɔadi nkonim - Ɔsahene Alpha: {alpha_score}, Ɔsahene Beta: {beta_score}

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ntotoho a enni mu. Fa: A:5, B:10, C:5
invalid_move.invalid_field: Mfiri a enni mu din. Mmeae pa: {field_names}
invalid_move.wrong_allocation_value: Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde nneɛma a wɔkyekyɛ no nyinaa yɛ integers ahorow.
invalid_move.incorrect_total_units: Wopɛ sɛ wobɛhyɛ {num_total_units} units. Current sum: {current_sum}
invalid_move.good_allocations: Ɔfã a wɔkyekyɛ no yɛ papa.
